As Corning (GLW) Share Value Declined, Lvm Capital Management LTD Has Boosted Holding; Yandex Nv (YNDX) Share Value Declined While Platinum Investment Management LTD Has Trimmed by $1.62 Million Its Position
June 5, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Lvm Capital Management Ltd increased its stake in Corning (GLW) by 20.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lvm Capital Management Ltd bought 13,150 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.29% with the market. The institutional investor held 76,679 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.14M, up from 63,529 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lvm Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Corning for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $23.55B market cap company. The stock increased 0.85% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $28.36. About 2.13M shares traded. Corning Incorporated (NYSE:GLW) has declined 8.49% since June 5, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.06% the S&P500.
Kerr Neilson decreased its stake in Yandex Nv (YNDX) by 25.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Platinum Investment Management Ltd sold 41,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 20.74% with the market. The hedge fund run by Kerr Neilson held 120,000 shares of the programming company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.73 million, down from 161,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Platinum Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Yandex Nv for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.65B market cap company. The stock increased 0.56% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $35.68. About 1.66M shares traded. Yandex N.V. (NASDAQ:YNDX) has risen 19.66% since June 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.09% the S&P500.
Among 20 analysts covering Corning Incorporated ( NYSE:GLW ), 6 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 30% are positive. Corning Incorporated had 49 analyst reports since July 30, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Citigroup maintained the shares of GLW in report on Friday, August 26 with “Buy” rating. The company was maintained on Tuesday, September 29 by Barclays Capital. The stock has “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank on Tuesday, September 15. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, November 2 by Goldman Sachs. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Wednesday, October 25 by Citigroup. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Friday, September 25 by RBC Capital Markets. Guggenheim initiated the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, January 4 report. Morgan Stanley upgraded Corning Incorporated (NYSE:GLW) on Thursday, May 31 to “Overweight” rating. Citigroup upgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Monday, April 3 report. The stock of Corning Incorporated (NYSE:GLW) earned “Mkt Perform” rating by Bernstein on Wednesday, February 1.

It also reduced its holding in Boeing (NYSE:BA) by 3,002 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 57,316 shares, and cut its stake in Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT).

It also increased its holding in Lam Research Corp (NASDAQ:LRCX) by 4,500 shares in the quarter, for a total of 6,700 shares, and has risen its stake in Nanostring Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:NSTG).
Analysts await Yandex N.V. (NASDAQ:YNDX) to report earnings on July, 27. They expect $0.25 earnings per share, up 25.00% or $0.05 from last year’s $0.2 per share.
